document.text:
Scenario 1: Different actors and independent actions.

Visitors must file a notice on arrival. Staff may work remotely.

Scenario 2: Independent duty and optional method.

Staff must sign each report. Staff may use a blue pen.

Scenario 3: Different seasonal branches.

In winter, visitors must carry a ski pass. In summer, visitors may rent a bicycle.
